mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT SUM(i.daily_rent_price_fen*i.quantity) FROM rental_order_item i WHERE i.rental_order_id=o.id) daily_rent_fen, (SELECT MIN(GREATEST(0,DATEDIFF(next.occupy_start_date,own.occupy_end_date)-1)) FROM inventory_reservation own JOIN inventory_reservation next ON next.sn_id=own.sn_id WHERE own.rental_order_id=o.id AND own.reservation_status='renting' AND own.sn_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT (next.rental_order_id <=> o.id) AND next.reservation_status IN ('held','paid_locked','renting','overdue_holding','disputed_holding') AND >own.occupy_end_date) sn_limit_days, (o.order_status='fulfilling' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_receipt_check c WHERE c.rental_order_id=o.id AND c.check_status IN ('confirmed','auto_confirmed')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_return_shipment s WHERE s.rental_order_id=o.id AND s.sent_at IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_return_check c WHERE c.rental_order_id=o.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_issue_report i WHERE i.rental_order_id=o.id AND i.fulfillment_effect='paused' AND i.issue_status NOT IN ('resolved','closed'))) renting FROM rental_order o WHERE o.id=#{orderId}
